name: tsek
description: Repository scripts. Each app keeps its own dependencies in frontend/ and backend/.

scripts.check: npm run check:frontend && npm run check:backend
scripts.check:frontend: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.check:backend: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm test --prefix backend
scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix frontend && npm ci --prefix backend
